cd /home/runner/workspace/ai-agent || exit 1
node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
const root=process.cwd();
const specs=[{"path":"backend/extension/browser/experience/recorder.js","old":"6ab4d03ac29ac39511fdb1dae2cb0cf6635eda94","sha":"8461571782dd409da6bd1aed695d4223f84be0af","base64":""},{"path":"backend/extension/browser/experience/experience_learning.js","old":"c254a6fccd6bb82bfde812536cc2b4361ca7ebb8","sha":"1d6c15972e3584744750ca14ae6678d16a528bbd","base64":""},{"path":"backend/extension/browser/experience/research.js","old":"2d843447faefbc745c9fae3c74137cb0375bcef0","sha":"6646f40a03ec511b31db4865fae7d6f70a04b0aa","base64":""},{"path":"backend/extension/browser/experience/index.js","old":null,"sha":"23961f6e491d8a5d7b30555a97876c3f4e22e1db","base64":""}];
const hash=b=>createHash('sha1').update('blob '+b.length+'\0').update(b).digest('hex');
const changes=[];
const exists=p=>{try{return fs.readFileSync(p)}catch(e){if(e.code==='ENOENT')return null;throw e}};
for(const s of specs){
  const f=path.resolve(root,s.path);
  if(!f.startsWith(root+path.sep))throw Error('unsafe path');
  if(fs.existsSync(f)&&fs.lstatSync(f).isSymbolicLink())throw Error('symlink target');
  const current=exists(f);
  const local=current===null?null:hash(current);
  const content=Buffer.from(s.base64,'base64');
  if(hash(content)!==s.sha)throw Error('payload hash mismatch '+s.path);
  if(local===s.sha){console.log('ALREADY_CURRENT',s.path);continue}
  if(local!==s.old)throw Error('LOCAL_CONFLICT '+s.path+' local='+local+' expected='+s.old);
  changes.push({path:s.path,file:f,old:current,bytes:content});
}
const serverPath=path.join(root,'backend/server.js');
const serverOld=fs.readFileSync(serverPath);
const serverText=serverOld.toString('utf8');
const anchor='app.use("/extension", express.static(path.join(__dirname, "extension")));';
const guard='// Keep Browser learning histories private; the rest of /extension stays unchanged.\napp.use("/extension/browser/experience/data", (_req, res) => res.sendStatus(404));\napp.use("/extension/browser/chatgpt/experience", (_req, res) => res.sendStatus(404));\n';
if(!serverText.includes(anchor))throw Error('SERVER_ANCHOR_MISSING');
const presentA=serverText.includes('app.use("/extension/browser/experience/data"');
const presentB=serverText.includes('app.use("/extension/browser/chatgpt/experience"');
if(presentA!==presentB)throw Error('SERVER_PARTIAL_GUARD_CONFLICT');
if(!presentA)changes.push({path:'backend/server.js',file:serverPath,old:serverOld,bytes:Buffer.from(serverText.replace(anchor,guard+anchor))});
console.log('PREFLIGHT_OK',JSON.stringify(changes.map(x=>x.path)));
const backupRoot=path.resolve(root,'..','.browser-experience-backups','deploy-'+Date.now());
fs.mkdirSync(backupRoot,{recursive:true,mode:0o700});
const written=[];
try{
 for(const c of changes){
   if(c.old!==null){const dest=path.join(backupRoot,c.path);fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest),{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(dest,c.old,{mode:0o600})}
   fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(c.file),{recursive:true});
   const temp=c.file+'.browser-exp-tmp';
   fs.writeFileSync(temp,c.bytes,{flag:'wx'});
   fs.renameSync(temp,c.file);
   written.push(c);
   console.log('UPDATED',c.path,'hash',hash(fs.readFileSync(c.file)));
 }
 const checks=[
  'backend/extension/browser/experience/recorder.js',
  'backend/extension/browser/experience/analyzer.js',
  'backend/extension/browser/experience/strategy_selector.js',
  'backend/extension/browser/experience/experience_learning.js',
  'backend/extension/browser/experience/index.js',
  'backend/extension/browser/experience/research.js',
  'backend/extension/browser/browser_service.js',
  'backend/extension/browser/browser_live.js',
  'backend/extension/browser/chatgpt_live.js',
  'backend/server.js'
 ];
 for(const f of checks){const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{encoding:'utf8'});if(r.status!==0)throw Error('SYNTAX '+f+' '+r.stderr)}
 console.log('ALL_SYNTAX_OK',checks.length);
 const t=spawnSync(process.execPath,['--test','backend/extension/browser/experience/experience.test.js'],{encoding:'utf8',timeout:40000});
 console.log('TEST_STDOUT',t.stdout?.slice(-10000));
 if(t.status!==0)throw Error('TEST_FAILED status='+t.status+' stderr='+t.stderr);
 console.log('TEST_PASS');
 console.log('DEPLOY_SUCCESS backup='+backupRoot);
}catch(e){
 console.log('DEPLOY_FAILURE',e.message);
 for(const c of written.reverse()){try{if(c.old===null)fs.rmSync(c.file,{force:true});else fs.writeFileSync(c.file,c.old);console.log('ROLLED_BACK',c.path)}catch(err){console.log('ROLLBACK_ERROR',c.path,err.message)}}
 process.exitCode=2;
}
